policy.canonicalRule: Coverage is evidence only; no character record is promoted to canonical runtime.

classification.noEffect: Only an explicit raw no-effect statement qualifies; missing/empty text never qualifies.
classification.unstructured: Raw talent text exists but no talent-modifiers record is present.
classification.uninvestigated: Raw talent text is unavailable and no explicit no-effect evidence exists.

criteria.noEffect: An explicit raw no-effect statement is present for every inspected passive field.
criteria.unstructured: At least one non-empty raw passive text field exists and no talent-modifiers record is present.
criteria.uninvestigated: No non-empty raw passive text is available and no explicit no-effect evidence exists.

classification.canonicalRule: Classification is evidence only; canonical runtime promotion remains forbidden.

classification.criteria: At least one non-empty raw passive text field exists and no talent-modifiers record is present.
unverifiedBoundaries: Independent provider/version agreement has not been established.
EffectSpec values (target, trigger, value, timing, element, and stacking) remain unverified.
No canonical runtime modifier is generated or promoted from this classification.
Raw prose may describe damage, healing, resources, utility, or state changes; prose is not structured calculation data.
